claims.claim: Arbitrators imposed annual wage increases of three percent through 2029 for more than 60,000 B.C. nurses after the union asked for eight percent a year.
claims.episode_span: Arbitrators have imposed annual wage increases of three percent through 2029
claims.source_title: B.C. nurses union 'gravely disappointed' with 3% wage hike in arbitrated settlement
claims.supporting_quote: Arbitrators have imposed annual wage increases of three per cent through to 2029 for British Columbia's more than 60,000 nurses, a decision their union president says has left nurses feeling “gravely disappointed" after they asked for eight per cent annually.

claims.claim: Sunshine Coast RCMP have identified the driver and located the truck and trailer in a Sechelt hit-and-run that killed a 16-year-old.
claims.episode_span: identified the driver and located the truck and trailer
claims.source_title: Driver identified, truck located in fatal Sunshine Coast hit-and-run involving teen: RCMP
claims.supporting_quote: Sunshine Coast RCMP say they have identified the driver and located the truck and trailer involved in their investigation into a hit-and-run collision that killed a 16-year-old boy in Sechelt, B.C., earlier this week.

claims.claim: Ahousaht on Flores Island got its first mini pharmacy; residents previously needed a water taxi to Tofino or help from neighbours for prescriptions.
claims.episode_span: A First Nation community on Flores Island, Ahousaht, has its first mini pharmacy.
claims.source_title: This First Nation community off Vancouver Island just got its first 'mini pharmacy'
claims.supporting_quote: Previously, Flores Island residents either needed money to take a water taxi to Tofino on Vancouver Island to get prescriptions, or relied on neighbours heading that way.

claims.claim: A non-profit is trying to acquire SRO buildings with Vancouver City Hall's support, and lawyer Scott Andersen told B.C. Supreme Court on Friday that tenants fear aggressive evictions and rent increases.
claims.episode_span: Lawyer Scott Andersen told B.C. Supreme Court on Friday
claims.source_title: Non-profit society trying to acquire SRO buildings, with Vancouver City Hall's support
claims.supporting_quote: SRO tenants are 'concerned because there's recently been a group of buyers who've been aggressively evicting tenants and raising rents' in other recently acquired buildings, lawyer Scott Andersen told B.C. Supreme Court on Friday

claims.claim: B.C.'s civil forfeiture director sued in B.C. Supreme Court to seize five Fraser Valley properties, vehicles, jewelry and about $38,000 cash allegedly tied to drug labs, and none of the allegations has been proven.
claims.episode_span: seeking forfeiture of five Fraser Valley properties
claims.source_title: B.C. moves to seize cars, cash, Rolexes and drug lab properties in the Fraser Valley
claims.supporting_quote: B.C.'s civil forfeiture director filed a lawsuit in B.C. Supreme Court against 10 owners and their companies seeking seizure of five properties allegedly used as sites for clandestine drug labs in the Chilliwack area

claims.claim: Police found 39 kg of fentanyl and 3,766 MDMA pills at a South Sumas Road property in Chilliwack during an Oct. 2, 2025 search.
claims.episode_span: including 39 kilograms of fentanyl and 3,766 MDMA pills
claims.source_title: B.C. moves to seize cars, cash, Rolexes and drug lab properties in the Fraser Valley
claims.supporting_quote: The next day, Oct. 2, 2025, police searched properties and vehicles and found chemicals, equipment and recipes at the South Sumas property, including drugs, such as 39 kg of fentanyl and 3,766 MDMA pills.

claims.claim: Justin Fauth and Carlos Martinez face criminal drug charges and are named in the civil forfeiture lawsuit.
claims.episode_span: Fauth and Martinez face criminal drug charges.
claims.source_title: B.C. moves to seize cars, cash, Rolexes and drug lab properties in the Fraser Valley
claims.supporting_quote: Justin Fauth and Carlos Martinez face criminal drug charges.
